'''Serrol Gathip''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] executive who met with [[Thel Erelen]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] at the [[Duro Delta Twelve]] shipyards, only to have meeting crashed by [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] agent [[Sedret Fain]].
